purpose: Design readings for two new network variants before the adsb_nn2 declaration, under the adsb_nn design protocol (configs/adsb_nn_design_v1.json): October only. (1) nmres: the v24 network (variant nnb, unchanged settings) trained on label minus the NM off-block clock proxy where the clock is present (tools/run_adsb_nn2.py target_offset nm_clock). Question: is it a better or more diverse committee member than further seeds of nnb? (2) nnl: nnb with LIRF's ordinary rows in fitting (the LIRF fill population still excluded, as the v22 LIRF CatBoosts). Question: does fitting LIRF change its non-LIRF October reading (can its seeds share the committee pool), and what does it give on October LIRF rows?

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_nn2.py --fold design: fit on the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09), monitor on its early-stop partition (2025-10); write the October predictions only.
protocol.never_read: No design run predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or the ranking months.
protocol.readings: tools/nn_design_report.py on the monitored non-LIRF October rows against the committee October reference (runs/adsb_nn/design/committee_october.parquet), and paired against the recorded nnb design seeds 1-8 (runs/adsb_nn/design/base_s1..s8): nmres seed n is compared with base seed n, and the mean of base 1..k plus nmres 1..k with the mean of base 1..2k (same compute). For nnl, additionally a descriptive October reading on LIRF non-population rows against the cross-fitted v9 (scratch/v24/2025-10.parquet).
protocol.decision: nmres enters the adsb_nn2 declaration only if the equal-compute mixed seed mean (base 1..k + nmres 1..k) beats the base mean of 2k seeds on the October committee-blend reading at its best weight; otherwise the declaration uses further nnb seeds. nnl seeds may share the committee pool only if nnl's single-seed non-LIRF blend readings lie inside the range of the eight base seeds; otherwise nnl serves only the LIRF tables.

features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)
